rationale: Integration round 3: six workstreams plus main, measured together under a repaired instrument. Regenerated ONCE, against the final tree, after all seven merges -- never mid-sequence. THE REASON ALL THREE ARE INVALID IS PROVENANCE, NOT MOVEMENT. contentRevision moved a622452a3b55e38fd902a2d3264b44d7 -> 5be755471cd46620625b01b77d2888a7 (W24 gave every territory.json record a libraryUpkeepMultiplier, contracts.md 2.7) -> 5a2a97df2d263e4a629aa2a5f3037020 (W21 gave every technique an envelope, 2.1, and added two unease constants to god-constant.json). The final value is neither branch's recorded successor, for the fourth time in this campaign: W24 and W21 were both cut from a622452a, neither contained the other, and each recorded itself as that revision's heir exactly as W6, W8 and W17 each did to 2512ea02. The gate refuses cross-build comparison, so a delta under a moved hash is a category error rather than a regression. EVERY MECHANISM, AND ITS MEASURED DELTA. W18 instrument-repair: control-gated scoring, the exploit margin excluding all three probes with EXPLOIT_MARGIN_MIN 0.05 -> 0.10, and a correlation term that contributes the weaker of Pearson and Spearman only at three or more winners. NOT ON THE RULES PATH: all three gates read delta 0.00000 on every metric at that merge, and packages/sim-core is byte-identical to round 2 across the whole round. W22 knowledge-observability: a per-node, location-aware census as a diagnostic projection outside the observation vector. Additive and inert -- gates 0.00000, OBSERVATION_LAYOUT_DIGEST unmoved at 46182c35d829b205, and nothing in the rules path imports it. W19 horizon-sweep: twelve horizon sweep specs, tooling and docs, plus one additive --sample flag. Touches nothing under packages/; gates 0.00000. W24 university-siting: territory moves from a content aggregate into world state and a university stands in a kind of country. WORLD_SCHEMA_VERSION 4 -> 5. Its own regeneration measured 29 of 30 figures inside tolerance, and named the mechanism: five territory-holding entities are materialized on the first world tick, entity handles are what deriveActorStream keys on (contracts.md 6), so every later entity draws a different per-actor stream. The siting arithmetic is exactly neutral in these three gates by construction -- the reference academy sits at the documented default, arable-lowland, whose capacity and upkeep multipliers are both fp(1024). W21 timing-and-envelopes: technique cost curves over an acquisition's duration (sound-design 4.1) and the intervention-timing surcharge mirrored into the mask (5.2). WORLD_SCHEMA_VERSION 5 -> 6, because W21 authored its bar-phase migration as a second 4 -> 5 and two revision 5s cannot both exist; renumbered before either shipped, which is the only moment it is safe. W21 ON TOP OF W24 IS A SMALL EFFECT ON THE REFERENCE UNIVERSE. At 600 ticks: referenceNodesKnown 29.60 -> 29.82 and referenceNodesGained 27.10 -> 27.32, both +0.22 at 2.09 SE and the largest moves anywhere; referenceLibraryDepth 10.240 -> 10.405 (0.49 SE); referenceGrimoires 84.16 -> 83.40 (-0.48 SE); referencePopulation 129.255 -> 129.375 (0.27 SE); referencePeakPopulation unmoved at 216. At the 240-tick horizon: referenceKnowledgeInstances 1023.90 -> 1033.34 (1.03 SE); referencePeakPopulation 365 -> 353 (-1.51 SE), which walks back the one figure W24 had over tolerance; referenceLibraryDepth 25.470 -> 25.685 (0.30 SE); referenceGrimoires 359.395 -> 361.300 (0.22 SE). At 2400 ticks: referenceNodesKnown and referenceNodesGained both delta 0.00000, referenceKnowledgeInstances 2631.00 -> 2515.94 (-0.27 SE), referenceLibraryDepth 12.844 -> 11.250 (-0.38 SE), referenceLivingMages 106.19 -> 101.13 (-0.25 SE), referencePopulation 19084.4 -> 19716.7 (0.26 SE), referencePeakPopulation 50230 -> 50039 (-0.30 SE). Not one figure in any of the three gates is outside tolerance. W25 spec-refresh: vision.md brought up to what was built. Documentation only; vision.md has zero runtime parsers, and the ten tests that parse contracts.md all pass. MERGE OF origin/main: w17/value-sensitive-acquirer arriving a second time as real commits, where round 2 had squash-merged it. Content-equivalent, so contentRevision did not move; the tree keeps its NUL-free autonomy.ts and keeps traditionIndex out in favour of W13's tradition content id. THE ONE CROSS-BRANCH INTERACTION, and it is in a test rather than in these files: W21 lost orc's separation from elf to its envelopes and pinned the loss in a form that would reopen the day it separated again. It separated on the merge -- orc's slowest seed 37 -> 29 against an elf floor of 36 -- by W24's RNG re-keying. That is a fact about the instrument and not about the game: a six-seed interval moved because entity allocation changed, and it happened to move the way task 9.9 wants. NO GOLDEN FIXTURE WAS REGENERATED OR CHANGED at any of the seven merges; the three fixture digests are byte-identical to round 2 and were checked at every step. All 4038 tests in 285 files pass. This file is a measurement, not a balance claim: release-plan.md forbids a balance claim before 0.5.0, and every magnitude these changes added carries tuningStatus untuned. The full merge-by-merge record is docs/superpowers/plans/integration-round-3.md.
